record.reason: The paper empirically analyzes pretrained model reuse across 17,718 natural-science papers and reports adaptation/testing as common patterns. It is a literature study, not an inference optimization; external validity is limited by selected journals and field distribution.
record.title: An Empirical Investigation of Pre-Trained Deep Learning Model Reuse in the Scientific Process
